title: 第9章 大战第二只得手第10章 炼制法器三颗凝金晶元丹
content_zh:
“按计划行事。”
石锋压低声音，目光扫过众人，“我来牵制，吸引它的注意力。秋霞，你修炼的是碧木功，伺机缠住，攻击其腰腹弱点。小卫，顾道友，你们两人协同正面牵制，务必不能给它恢复的机会。逸凡，你修为稍弱，等我们缠住，你便进入采摘金晶果，记住采摘之后立刻撤退，不然一旦被堵在洞中，那就麻烦了。”
“是！”
几人纷纷点头。
石锋：“我再次强调一点，若事不可为，优先保全自身。”
“好。”
“行动开始，我先将其引出来。”
石锋低喝一声，猛然跃出。
手掐法诀，一道下品法术：金光刺激射入洞中。
这动静瞬间惊醒了金晶豹！
“吼！”
洞中，传来怒吼，金晶豹一跃而出，碧绿的瞳孔瞬间锁定石锋，带着被惊扰的暴怒，化作一道金色闪电扑来！
利爪带着撕裂空气的尖啸，狠狠拍在玄铁盾上。
石锋连忙祭出中品防御法器：玄铁盾。
玄铁盾暴涨，将石锋护住，刹那间防御大增。
“铛！”
火星四溅。
石锋闷哼一声，身形倒退，但竟硬生生扛住了这炼气六层妖兽的含怒一击！
“动手！”
胡秋霞娇叱一声，身化流影，中品法器‘秋水剑’祭出，如毒蛇般刺向金晶豹相对柔软的腰腹。

石卫也怒吼祭出中品法器‘碧金刀’，刀风凌厉，与石锋一左一右形成夹击。
顾景元这边，也是祭出中品法器，裂金剑，正面直刺。
金晶豹异常敏捷，腰身一扭，便以覆盖着晶体的坚硬背部硬接了胡秋霞一剑，发出刺耳摩擦声，同时长尾如钢鞭般扫向石卫。
石卫急忙横刀格挡，却被巨力震得气血翻涌，连连后退。
战况激烈，金晶豹凭借强悍的肉身和修为，以一敌四竟不落下风，反而将石锋四人逼退。
“娄逸凡，快，进去采摘。”
石锋大喝。
“好。”
娄逸凡立刻身形一闪，朝着洞口冲去。
金晶豹见状，眼中怒气大涨，攻击更加凶猛。
胡秋霞看准时机，双手掐诀：“缠绕藤，起！”
数根粗壮的绿色藤蔓破土而出，迅速缠向金晶豹的四足。
虽然藤蔓瞬间就被金晶豹挣断大半，但这一下迟滞，为三人创造了绝佳的机会！
“一起出手！”
content_en:
"Follow the plan."
Shi Feng lowered his voice and glanced at everyone, "I will contain it and attract its attention. Qiuxia, you practice the Green Wood Technique, waiting for an opportunity to entangle it and attack its weak points in the waist and abdomen. Xiaowei and fellow Taoist Gu, the two of you work together to contain it head-on and make sure not to give it a chance to recover. Yifan, your cultivation is a little weak. When we entangle it, you go in to pick the golden crystal fruit. Remember to retreat immediately after picking it, otherwise it will be in trouble if it is blocked in the hole."
"Yes!"
Several people nodded.
Shi Feng: "I would like to emphasize once again that if nothing can be done, priority should be given to protecting yourself."
"Okay."
"When the action begins, I'll lead him out first."
Shi Feng gave a low shout and jumped out suddenly.
Hand pinching technique, a low-grade spell: golden light stimulates the injection into the hole.
This movement instantly woke up Jin Jingbao!
"Roar!"
In the cave, there was a roar, and the golden crystal leopard jumped out. Its green pupils locked on Shi Feng instantly, and with the anger of being disturbed, it turned into a golden lightning and pounced!
The sharp claws struck the black iron shield with a scream that tore through the air.
Shi Feng quickly used a mid-level defensive weapon: the Black Iron Shield.
The black iron shield surged, protecting Shi Feng, and his defense increased instantly.
"Cang!"
Sparks flew everywhere.
Shi Feng groaned and fell back, but he managed to withstand the angry blow of the sixth-level Qi-refining monster!
"Do it!"
Hu Qiuxia gave a sweet scolding, transformed into a flowing shadow, and used the medium-grade magical weapon 'Qiu Shui Sword' to stab at the relatively soft waist and abdomen of the Golden Crystal Leopard like a poisonous snake.
Shi Wei also roared and sacrificed the middle-grade magical weapon 'Bi Jin Dao'. The sword was fierce and formed a flanking attack with Shi Feng on the left and right.
On Gu Jingyuan's side, he also used a medium-grade magic weapon, a split gold sword, and stabbed it straight in the front.
The Golden Crystal Leopard was extremely agile. With a twist of its waist, it used its hard back covered with crystals to catch Hu Qiuxia's sword. It made a harsh friction sound, and at the same time, its long tail swept towards the stone guard like a steel whip.
Shi Wei hurriedly blocked with his sword, but was shocked by the huge force and his blood surged, and he retreated continuously.
The battle was fierce. Jin Jingbao relied on his powerful physical body and cultivation level to defeat four enemies. Instead, he forced Shi Feng and the others back.
"Lou Yifan, hurry up, go in and pick."
Shi Feng shouted.
"Okay."
Lou Yifan immediately dodged and rushed towards the entrance of the cave.
When the Golden Crystal Leopard saw this, his eyes filled with anger and his attack became even more ferocious.
Hu Qiuxia saw the right moment and made a hand gesture: "Wrap the vine, rise!"
Several thick green vines broke out of the ground and quickly wrapped around the Golden Crystal Leopard's legs.
Although most of the vines were broken by the Golden Crystal Leopard in an instant, this delay created an excellent opportunity for the three of them!
"Let's take action together!"
